name: Ossuary Reliquary

Traits.name: Sanctified Mending
Traits.text: The reliquary regains 20 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point and its ward is within 30 feet of it.
Traits.expresses: healing the loyal with holy light

Traits.name: Ward Bond
Traits.text: The reliquary is magically bound to a ward of its choosing, and it can have only one ward at a time. While the reliquary is within 60 feet of its ward, half of any damage the ward takes (round up) is transferred to the reliquary.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The reliquary makes two Gilt Censer attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Withering Wisp.

Actions.name: Gilt Censer
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. 19 (4d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) Necrotic damage.

Actions.name: Warden's Grace (2/Day)
Actions.text: The reliquary targets itself or one creature it can see within 60 feet. The target gains 33 (6d10) Temporary Hit Points, and its AC increases by 2 until the end of the reliquary's next turn.

Actions.name: Withering Wisp
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

lore: Raised from a desecrated shrine, the reliquary drags itself from church to church, weighing every soul it meets against the martyred saint's own loyalty.

generation.userConcept: a saint's reliquary that heals what is loyal and withers what is not
generation.cite: composition after Shield Guardian (CR 7) — Bound transfer, Regeneration, the measured 0.65 damage discount

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
lint_findings: type-damage-affinity: Actions/Gilt Censer: Necrotic damage on Construct — no official Construct deals Necrotic; re-theme the damage to the creature's substance (or the type itself is wrong)
